name: JG_FSCL_DOC_GEN_CNTRLS_ALL_F
description: This table contains Fiscal Document generation controls and default values for Fiscal Document generation.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOCUMENT_GEN_CNTRL_ID
columns.description: Fiscal document generation controls identifier.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Application event class of the transaction, such as requisition, purchase order and agreement, and release.

columns.name: ENTITY_CODE
columns.description: Entity code of the transaction, which indicates the type of transaction being created.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier of a functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Set up document fiscal classifications to classify transactions that require special documentation to accompany the transaction, as designated by the tax authority.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_START_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the beginning of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_END_DATE
columns.description: Date Effective Entity: indicates the date at the end of the date range within which the row is effective.

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the fiscal document options setup is enabled for the event class, legal entity, and legal reporting unit. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: FSCL_DOC_APPROVAL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the fiscal document approval process is required. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: FSCL_DOC_COMPLETION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the transaction can be completed before the fiscal document is generated. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates whether the Associate Fiscal Attributes user interface reflects the attributes that are required by the goods industry, service industry, or both.

columns.name: FREIGHT_APPLICABLE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the Associate Fiscal Attributes user interface reflects freight related attributes that are required by the goods industry. Valid values are Y and N.

columns.name: GOODS_SERIES
columns.description: Fiscal document series for the fiscal documents associated with goods.

columns.name: SERVICE_SERIES
columns.description: Fiscal document series for provisional receipt of services for the city tax authority.

columns.name: FSCL_ATTRIB_TEMPLATE_CODE
columns.description: The default template to be used for the defaulting fiscal attributes.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_TYPE
columns.description: Default value to be used as fiscal document contingency type. Valid values are Security Form, Contingency System of National Environment, and Declaration of Issuance Provided in Contingency.

columns.name: DEFAULT_CONT_REASON
columns.description: Default fiscal document contingency justification to be used.

columns.name: CONTINGENCY_SERIES
columns.description: Default fiscal document series for contingency fiscal documents.

columns.name: TRX_FD_TYPE_DETERMINANT
columns.description: Fiscal document type determinant, which indicates whether single or multiple fiscal documents are required for a transaction.

columns.name: FISCAL_DOC_MODEL_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the flow that FDG chooses to process. Values include Regular or Communication.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
